letter.to_address: Norman Regional Hospital Authority, P.O. Box 268961, Oklahoma City, OK 73126
letter.re_line: Re: No Surprises Act Complaint - Account FB-2026-000005
letter.body:
Dear Billing Office,

I am writing to dispute charges on my statement dated 2026-07-01 under the No Surprises Act.

Line 3 of my bill shows anesthesia for screening colonoscopy billed at $1,850.00. This service was provided by an out-of-network anesthesiologist at your in-network facility. Under 45 CFR 180.50 and 45 CFR 149.420, I should not owe out-of-network charges when an out-of-network provider delivers care at an in-network facility without my knowledge.

Your price file row 15227 lists the colonoscopy procedure (code 45378) with a discounted cash price of $1,503.60. I owe only the in-network cost sharing for the anesthesia line, not the full $1,850.00 billed amount.

I ask that you:

- Recalculate my bill to reflect only in-network cost sharing for line 3
- Pause collection efforts on this $1,850.00 amount while this dispute is open
- Respond by 2027-01-12 with an explanation of how you will resolve this

The original statement due date has passed. I am acting in good faith to resolve this promptly and ask for your cooperation in pausing collection while we work through this complaint.

Sincerely,
Taylor Fictional

Sources:
- The hospital's own standard-charges file, row 15227: 45378 Colonoscopy, Diagnostic, posted gross $2,506.00, discounted cash price $1,503.60 (file fetched 2026-09-13). https://www.normanregional.com/documents/PFS/736048282_norman-regional-health-system_standardcharges.csv
- 45 CFR 180.50 requires this hospital to publish its standard charges, including the discounted cash price, in a machine-readable file. https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-45/part-180
- 45 CFR 149.420 (No Surprises Act) limits a nonparticipating provider at a participating facility to the in-network cost-sharing amount. https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-45/part-149
